name: open_dt_parsed_min
note: share of rows whose open time parses (W1-5: a format bug once blanked 48%)

name: new_offset_ok_min
note: share of new-system open_date values without a non-zero offset (new_311.has_other_offset; ADR-020 reads +00 as Boston local)

name: median_open_hour_min
note: median open time in hours after midnight; legacy 12.6 and new system 13.5 in 2026-10

name: median_open_hour_max
note: real UTC would move the median 4 to 5 hours later (about 17.5 to 18.5)

name: published_rows_min
note: rows over the count in published_311_counts.csv (legacy years and the new-system export; the export only grows)

name: in_boston_min
note: share of raw rows with coordinates inside BOSTON_BOUNDS; about 99% in 2026-10

name: placed_per_year_min
note: share of requests placed in a unit in every year of 311_located (worst 2015 at about 98%)

name: placed_min_year_rows
note: years with fewer rows (a new year in early January) are left out of placed_per_year_min

name: case_id_ok_min
note: share of case ids present and not repeated below which the raw stage fails; any missing or repeated id is a warning (the parsers drop them)
